title: QA Automation Engineer L1
jobDescription:
Job Description: We are looking for an enthusiastic Entry-Level Automation Test Engineer to join our QA team. This is a great opportunity for recent graduates or those with up to one year of experience to build a career in automation testing for mobile applications, web applications, and APIs. You will work closely with experienced QA engineers and developers, learning best practices in test automation and quality assurance. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining automated test scripts for mobile, web, and API testing using Type Script. Learn and utilise Appium for mobile automation (Android and i OS) and Webdriver IO for web automation. Support the implementation of Behaviour Driven Development (BDD) practices using Cucumber. Help build and maintain reusable and scalable test frameworks. Participate in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. Collaborate with development and QA teams to understand requirements and identify test scenarios. Analyse test results, document defects, and support the resolution process. Document test cases, execution results, and contribute to process improvements. Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in automation testing. Required Skills and

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 0–1 year of experience in automation testing for mobile, web, or APIs (internship or academic project experience is acceptable). Basic programming knowledge in Type Script or Java Script. Exposure to Appium and/or Webdriver IO is a plus. Familiarity with BDD concepts and Cucumber is a plus. Understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes. Willingness to learn new tools and technologies. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Effective communication and collaboration skills.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman) Exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness) is a plus. Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git) is a plus. Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies. Tools & Technologies: Type Script, Java Script Appium (preferred) Webdriver IO (preferred) Cucumber (BDD) API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured, etc.) CI/CD tools We offer a competitive total rewards package including a base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set, and location. For those in eligible roles, discretionary incentive compensation may be awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. title: Senior Technical Consultant
jobDescription:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead the design, creation, and maintenance of robust upgrade scripts and processes for CORE and STORE platforms. Collaborate with Product Development to transform and migrate upgrade processes to Docker containerization and other modern deployment methods. Execute complex implementations and upgrades, ensuring minimal disruption to client operations. Maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize automation scripts using Power Shell and Python for deployment and configuration. Install, configure, and manage Saa S product releases, including using DSC for deployments. Provide L2/L3 technical support, including root cause analysis (RCA) and resolution for escalated issues related to upgrades and hotfixes. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, processes, and troubleshooting guides. Work closely with development and support teams to facilitate smooth upgrades and resolve technical issues. Mentor junior engineers and provide guidance on best practices. Willingness to work in shifts as required to support global operations or critical project timelines.

QUALIFICATIONS:
5–8 years of relevant experience in software upgrades, deployment automation, and process transformation. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent work experience. Strong expertise in scripting languages (Power Shell, Python), automation frameworks, and containerization (Docker). Proven ability in advanced troubleshooting, RCA, and implementing solutions for complex technical issues. Prior experience in retail environments is a plus. Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware and Hyper-V is an added advantage. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience mentoring and training junior staff. Strong leadership, collaboration, and project management skills. We offer a competitive total rewards package including a base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set, and location. title: Software Developer L1
jobDescription: Responsibilities Implement MCP tools that wrap Aptos domain APIs — inventory, orders, customer, store operations — with typed Pydantic schemas, tests, and clear LLM-facing descriptions. Contribute features to Foundry's catalog, testing, and deployment workflows, and to Concierge agent capabilities under guidance from senior engineers. Write well-tested Python (pytest, high coverage expected) against Fast API services, and keep code passing lint/type gates (ruff, mypy). Package services in Docker, deploy via Helm and Harness/Git Hub Actions pipelines, and fix issues surfaced by the security gate (bandit, trivy, pip-audit). Add tracing and metrics to your code (Open Telemetry, Prometheus) and use Langfuse traces to understand and debug agent behavior. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and on-call rotation as you grow; document what you build. Required Qualifications 1 to 3 years of professional software engineering experience (or strong internship/project record) with solid Python fundamentals. Experience building and testing web APIs (Fast API, Flask, or Django) and working with relational or analytical databases. Familiarity with Docker and Git-based CI workflows; willingness to learn Kubernetes, Helm, and AWS. Genuine interest in LLM applications — coursework, side projects, or professional exposure to prompting, agents, or model APIs. Strong testing habits and receptiveness to code review feedback. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to Lang Chain/Lang Graph, MCP, or LLM provider SDKs (Anthropic, Open AI, Bedrock). Basic Kubernetes experience or AWS familiarity (EKS, IAM, S3). Experience with Kafka, Snowflake, or Postgres. Interest in AI safety topics: guardrails, PII handling, tool authorization. title: Sr. Architect L3
jobDescription: Responsibilities Architecture & Technical Leadership Support and execute solution architecture for assigned product areas and cross-platform capabilities (e.g., pricing/promotions, inventory availability, order orchestration, customer/loyalty, POS integrations). Apply and uphold architecture standards: layering, service boundaries, domain models, API guidelines, eventing patterns, and coding practices as established by senior architects. Participate in and contribute to technical design reviews, author architecture decision records (ADRs), and support technical risk assessments for assigned features. Drive modernization initiatives (cloud readiness, decomposition, re-platforming, dependency rationalization, observability). Collaborate with Professional Services on reference architectures for implementations, upgrades, and complex customer integrations. Non-Functional Excellence Ensure systems meet SLAs for performance, availability, resiliency, scalability, and security. Define patterns for caching, data consistency, idempotency, retries, rate limiting, and disaster recovery. Champion observability: logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and operational runbooks. Engineering Enablement & Mentorship Collaborate with senior engineers and tech leads; actively contribute to raising engineering standards within the team. Partner with QA and Dev Ops to embed quality and automation into the delivery lifecycle (shift-left testing, CI/CD controls). Contribute hands-on where needed (prototypes, spikes, performance investigations, complex fixes). Must-Have Requirements 6–10 years of software engineering experience, including at least 1–2 years in an architecture or technical lead capacity. Proficiency in C# / .NET — strong command of the language, async patterns, dependency injection, and writing testable, clean code. Working knowledge of React — ability to review, guide, and contribute to front-end architecture decisions; familiarity with component design, hooks, and state management (Redux/Context). Practical and hands-on AWS experience covering core services: EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, Cloud Watch, and IAM. Solid understanding of distributed systems and service-oriented architectures (microservices and/or modular monoliths). Demonstrated ability to translate high-level architectural designs into detailed, implementation-ready technical specifications. Experience with REST API design, security (OAuth2/OIDC), versioning, and integration patterns (sync/async). Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code concepts. Good communication skills to articulate architecture choices to engineering peers and participate in cross-team discussions. Strong understanding of: API design, security, and versioning Data modelling and persistence (SQL/No SQL) and integration patterns Performance engineering and troubleshooting in production systems Secure coding and threat modelling fundamentals Good to Have Retail domain experience: POS, OMS, pricing/promotions, inventory, returns, loyalty, taxation. Exposure to LLM integration patterns and MCP server contracts. AI tool exposure. Experience with event-driven architecture (e.g., Kafka), CQRS patterns, and workflow/orchestration concepts. Experience building platform capabilities for multi-tenant enterprise Saa S. Exposure to AI-assisted engineering practices (code quality, test generation, operational insights). Tech Stack : Backend: Java/.NET (as applicable), REST APIs, integration services Data: SQL + caching; eventing/streaming (where applicable) Cloud/Dev Ops: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, observability tools Security: OAuth2/OIDC, secrets management, secure SDLC AWS Services including RDS. Success Measures. Architecture standards adopted and measurable reduction in defects/rewrites. Improved service performance/reliability and clearer operational posture (dashboards, alerts, runbooks). Faster, safer delivery through reference architectures and reusable patterns. Stronger alignment across product, engineering, QA, and PS on implementation-ready designs.
